title: One-day hydraulic persistence of the admitted FMC separated surface-plus-groundwater branch
purpose: Test whether the relative FMC hydraulic advantage admitted at one hour remains physically executable and, only if the FMC-only preflight passes, competitive with R2 over a 24-hour no-ET accumulation window without changing any D12-D27 process law.

predecessor_authority.D20: The separated prescribed-infiltration plus fixed-water-table FMC branch retained candidacy over one hour; relative advantage versus R2 persisted in the last quarter, while absolute bias grew with time.
predecessor_authority.D24: Native rainfall plus active fixed-water-table composition retained candidacy over a short 160-s window.
predecessor_authority.D25: Compiled FMC showed a large shared-host cost advantage, but formal performance remains blocked by MP-8.
predecessor_authority.D28: Native ET/root-active trajectory remains externally blocked; D29 therefore contains zero ET/root withdrawal and does not bypass D28.
predecessor_authority.implication: D29 extends only duration of the already-qualified D20 separated continuous-infiltration branch.

initial_state.surface_component: D16 I_DEEP connected fronts: z_101=120 cm linearly to z_199=10 cm
initial_state.groundwater_component: D13 G25: H_j=0.25*abs(psi(theta_j)) above fixed water table at 160 cm
initial_state.mapping: exact finite-volume cell averages to R16/R2 if Stage 2 is authorized

matched_boundaries.top: prescribed infiltrating flux q_in=factor*Ksat; native SWAP top_flux=-q_in
matched_boundaries.bottom: fixed zero pressure head / fixed water table at z=160 cm
matched_boundaries.surface_groundwater_contact_or_merge: not allowed in D29; if encountered, preflight closes D29 before any R16/R2 exposure

FMC_algorithm.authority: unchanged D20 composition of D13/D14/D15/D17 qualified operations
per_step: reserve K(theta_i)*dt gray-bin direct throughflow from prescribed top supply
allocate all remaining supply to already connected surface fronts with D15 finite-volume accounting and D14 Eq.18 kinematics
advance D13 groundwater fronts by Eq.21 and conservative relaxation
bottom outward exchange = gray direct throughflow - groundwater-front storage change
require connected surface and groundwater intervals remain strictly separated

checks: all four histories complete all 8640 FMC steps
every step has surface supply >= gray-bin demand
all residual surface supply is absorbed by already connected fronts
no dry-bin activation, ponding or runoff
no surface-groundwater contact/merge or slug state
all front states remain finite and physical
step and global finite-volume ledgers remain <=1e-12 cm
all four histories have identical cumulative prescribed top input
stage1_FMC_only_preflight.failure_rule: Any failure closes D29 before generating new R16/R2 trajectories. Do not change factors, sequence, duration, lambda, bins, process step, equations or state-transition rules.

stage2_if_preflight_passes.activation_rule: May be added only after immutable Stage-1 PASS evidence is observed under this exact preregistration.
stage2_if_preflight_passes.numerical_authority: D4 integrated-water-depth strict-first research policy; hard accepted transaction mass gate 1e-12 cm
positive_rule: all R16/R2/FMC histories complete with integrity
full-day FMC bottom-flux RMSE <= R2 and sign errors <= R2
last-six-hour FMC total-storage, cumulative-bottom-exchange, mapped-theta and bottom-flux RMSE each <= R2

purpose_boundary.LONG_TERM_REGIONAL_WATER_BALANCE: D29 is a one-day hydraulic accumulation discriminator only. Even a positive result does not establish seasonal or application acceptance.
purpose_boundary.GROUNDWATER_COUPLED_MANY_COLUMN: Fixed water table only; live coupling absent.

successor_logic.if_stage1_passes: Persist Stage-1 evidence and separately authorize the already-frozen Stage-2 comparator without changing science.
successor_logic.if_stage1_contact_or_other_branch_transi: Close D29 separated-branch persistence. A later contact-capable long-window design must explicitly bind D19 and any additional surface-state transitions; do not silently widen D29.
successor_logic.if_stage2_positive: Retain FMC for bounded longer hydraulic balance research, still excluding ET/application acceptance.
successor_logic.if_stage2_negative: Do not retune FMC; restrict long-window candidacy and preserve shorter D20/D24 positive evidence.
